interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation.text: P0 (readiness) or C1 (manipulation check) failed in a majority of seeds. This is an uninformative substrate-readiness result, not a claim verdict -- the ventral leg's own detection floor was not established prior to this, its first attempt.

preconditions.name: valuation_heads_grounded
preconditions.description: Pearson correlation between predicted valence (benefit_eval_head - harm_eval_head on live z_world) and the env's true (benefit_exposure - harm_exposure) on a positive-control episode clears the grounding floor -- asserts the grounding REEAgent.actor_critic_reward()'s own docstring requires before trusting benefit_eval/harm_eval. (Seed-majority gate used for the actual P0 verdict is reported separately under summary.n_p0a_pass.)
preconditions.control: positive-control episode with genuine harm/benefit transitions

preconditions.name: rpe_signal_detectable
preconditions.description: Mean |delta_t| over the positive-control episode clears the RPE detection floor (not pre-established for this signal; calibrated empirically, see the filed report for the observed distribution). (Seed-majority gate used for the actual P0 verdict is reported separately under summary.n_p0b_pass.)
preconditions.control: positive-control episode with genuine harm/benefit transitions
